light_description: Finnish NPN-silicon Fuzz Face-style fuzz with bias, pre-gain, high-pass and low-pass shaping; designed to range from overdrive to gated/furry fuzz.
Fuzzrocity variant with clean blend and master-volume controls, aimed especially at bass while remaining useful for guitar.
Finnish Rangemaster-inspired booster with adjustable boost intensity and frequency range, usable from full-frequency boost to treble boost.

Swedish original design combining a heavily digital-looking control concept with an effects/synthesis architecture; retained as a dirt-adjacent central record because the builder markets it as a drive.
Swedish fuzz-based guitar synthesizer with PWM control, octave down/up and alternating-octave modulation.
Expanded Arcadiator version with arcade-style controls and expression-pedal input.
Fuzz with a theremin-like oscillator producing one or two octaves above the input.
Discrete phase-locked-loop fuzz with sawtooth output and vibrato-oriented processing.
Fuzz with freely tunable oscillator and warp mode.
Lo-fi fuzz using record/playback behavior around a toy-sound IC.
Dynamic fuzz using asymmetric wavefolding to create a strong octave-up character.
CMOS square-wave fuzz with a strong octave-up component.
Fuzz with PWM modulation and octave-down processing.
Discrete transistor-only guitar synthesizer and fuzz derived from the Arcadiator concept.
Chaotic PLL-based fuzz and noisemaker design.
Square-wave fuzz combined with XOR-logic ring modulation and stutter modulation.
Square-wave fuzz combined with XOR-logic ring modulation.
Older Parasit Studio distortion project documented in the builder's archived construction resources.

Archived Parasit Studio overdrive project listed in the builder's historical stripboard resources.
Archived Parasit Studio fuzz project listed in the builder's historical stripboard and etch resources.

Norwegian starved-germanium fuzz with noise gate.
Norwegian TS-type overdrive with additional gain.
Norwegian germanium bender fuzz.

Standalone fuzz section derived from the Monito blend-fuzz family.
Norwegian CMOS/JFET textured overdrive emphasizing unusual clipping texture.

Norwegian octave-down blend fuzz; listed as discontinued/in revision in the current site snapshot.
